title: Split admin CSS into product-surface modules
description: Refactor assets/css/eit-admin.css into bounded CSS modules by admin surface without changing selectors or visual behavior.
objective: Remove the 1290-line admin CSS monolith so future admin polish does not create cross-page regressions.
expected_outputs: Admin CSS modules for shell, cards/forms, preset screens, CPT screens, diagnostics, and utilities
No selector rename unless separately approved
acceptance_criteria: Existing admin pages render with equivalent selectors.
Each CSS module stays below the plugin line budget.
No visual feature is added during extraction.
verification: CSS brace check passes if available.
Browser or screenshot smoke is queued for Guilherme when visual nuance matters.
php scripts/verify-line-budget.php --strict passes or reports only tracked transition debt.

budgets.validation_budget: CSS syntax/brace, line budget, visual smoke

risks: CSS module extraction can silently alter cascade order.
Shared utility selectors can leak between admin pages.
Visual equivalence needs Guilherme QA if many screens must be compared.
